bounded_host_request.command:
cd /home/admin1/projects/libral-vault || exit 31
printf 'VAULT_HEAD='; git rev-parse HEAD
printf 'VAULT_STATUS='; docker inspect --format '{{.State.Status}}/{{if .State.Health}}{{.State.Health.Status}}{{end}}' libral-vault-libral-vault-1
printf 'TUNNEL_STATUS='; docker inspect --format '{{.State.Status}}/{{.State.ExitCode}}' astera_v8-astera-v8-cloudflared-1
printf 'SHARE='; stat -c '%a/%u:%g' /run/user/1000/astera-v8-tunnel-vault
printf 'TMPFS='; stat -f -c '%T' /run/user/1000/astera-v8-tunnel-vault
printf 'TARGET='; test -e /run/user/1000/astera-v8-tunnel-vault/astera_v8_cloudflare_tunnel_token && echo PRESENT || echo MISSING
printf 'CONFIG_FLAGS='; docker inspect --format '{{range .Config.Env}}{{println .}}{{end}}' libral-vault-libral-vault-1 | awk -F= '/^LIBRAL_VAULT_ASTERA_V8_TUNNEL_(SECRET_ID|RUNTIME_DIR)=/{print $1"=SET"}'
